heading: The Studio
intro: Meaning “heaven-like,” we believe in using naturally produced, sustainable and earth friendly products. We believe our passion is our purpose, and virtue over vanity.

members.name: Kayla Dar
members.title: Glamour Consultant · Stylist · Barber
bio: Kayla began Empyrean Beauty and Barber Studio with 17 years of experience, 3,300 hours and a passion for continuing education. She has studied with celebrity stylists through the educational opportunities Hattori Hanzo Shears has to offer.

With a deep love for glamour and fashion, Kayla also believes deeply in using products that are environmentally friendly. This led her to developing her business, Luxe Teeth Whitening, to further offer a GMO-free and vegan based whitening system to ensure our guests leave with a smile.

members.name: Brandy Pruitt
members.title: Additional Services
bio: Brandy rounds out the studio with dedicated skincare services — an added convenience for guests who want to leave feeling fully refreshed.
